title: Passage 20
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: You will be really embarrassed if someone sees you talking to yourself, but don't feel bad about it.
sentences.cn: 如果有人看到你在自言自语，你可能会觉得很尴尬，但不用觉得这很糟糕。

sentences.en: It actually has a lot of advantages.
sentences.cn: 它实际上有很多好处。

sentences.en: Thinking is good for the brain.
sentences.cn: 思考对大脑有益。

sentences.en: Talking to yourself loud is like showing this quiet inner speech.
sentences.cn: 大声地自言自语就像是把无声的内心独白展示出来。

sentences.en: It can help us do better in different areas.
sentences.cn: 它可以帮助我们在不同的领域中表现得更好。

sentences.en: For example, a badminton or baseball champion might use self-talk while holding their bats.
sentences.cn: 例如，一位羽毛球或棒球冠军可能会在握着球拍（或球棒）时自言自语。

sentences.en: A policeman or policewoman may use words like 'you can do this' to help him or her stay calm in stressful situations.
sentences.cn: 一名男警察或女警察可能会用诸如“你能做到”这样的话，来帮助自己在充满压力的情况下保持冷静。

sentences.en: Talking to yourself in the third person can help us manage bad feelings.
sentences.cn: 以第三人称自言自语可以帮助我们管理负面情绪。

sentences.en: A researcher said that when he is feeling nervous during a flight, he talks to himself,
sentences.cn: 一位研究人员说，当他在飞行途中感到紧张时，他会跟自己说：“没关系的，杰森他已经坐过成千上万次飞机了。”

sentences.en: 'It's OK, Jason has been on thousands of flights.'
sentences.cn: 一位研究人员说，当他在飞行途中感到紧张时，他会跟自己说：“没关系的，杰森他已经坐过成千上万次飞机了。”

sentences.en: This can help him to see things from a different aspect.
sentences.cn: 这可以帮助他从不同的角度看待问题。

sentences.en: When encouragement comes from oneself, it adds to self-confidence, making you feel like an eagle flying high.
sentences.cn: 当鼓励来自自身的时候，它可以增加自信，让你感觉自己就像一只展翅高飞的鹰。

sentences.en: A study invited 72 tennis players to take part in some matches.
sentences.cn: 一项研究邀请了72名网球运动员参加比赛。

sentences.en: Players were put into two groups: one group said nothing while playing, and the other talked to themselves.
sentences.cn: 选手们被分为两组：一组在比赛时什么都不说，另一组则会和自己说话。

sentences.en: They found that the winners were often the self-talkers.
sentences.cn: 他们发现，获胜者往往是那些会自言自语的人。

sentences.en: They showed more confidence than those in the silent group.
sentences.cn: 他们比沉默组的选手表现得更加自信。

sentences.en: Self-talk also helps to improve memory.
sentences.cn: 自言自语还有助于提高记忆力。

sentences.en: Researchers tested four different ways to memorise things: reading silently, reading aloud, listening to someone else read,
sentences.cn: 研究人员测试了四种不同的记忆方法：默读、大声朗读、听别人朗读以及听自己朗读的录音。

sentences.en: and listening to a recording of oneself reading.
sentences.cn: 研究人员测试了四种不同的记忆方法：默读、大声朗读、听别人朗读以及听自己朗读的录音。

sentences.en: Those who read out loud recalled the best, because the information becomes a long-term memory more easily.
sentences.cn: 大声朗读的人回忆的效果最好，因为那些信息更容易成为长期记忆。

sentences.en: Mastering self-talk can give you a tiger's determination.
sentences.cn: 掌握自言自语可以赋予你老虎般的意志。

sentences.en: Next time you visit the dentist, feel free to talk to yourself.
sentences.cn: 下次去看牙医时，不妨大胆地自言自语。
